content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(MP-002 LDAP SPN Sweep From Non-Typical Host) OR BIOC(MP-002 Service Account Used Interactively) OR BIOC(MP-002 Service Account Remote SMB Authentication On Workstation)
rules.name: Kerberoast PtH Lateral Movement Same Identity Stitch

rules.logic: BIOC(MP-002 LDAP SPN Sweep From Non-Typical Host) AND (BIOC(MP-002 Service Account Used Interactively) OR BIOC(MP-002 Service Account Remote SMB Authentication On Workstation))
